sections.title: Claim
sections.note: Draft for review. Amounts exclude GST; the tax invoice comes from your accounting ledger.
sections.sql: select k.code as claim,p.code as project,p.name as contract,c.name as customer,k.claim_no,k.period_end,k.status,k.due_on,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from claims k join projects p on p.id=k.project_id join customers c on c.id=p.customer_id where k.id=$1

sections.title: Value of work
sections.sql: select k.earned_to_date as work_completed_to_date,k.previously_claimed as less_previously_claimed,k.this_claim as this_claim,k.retention as less_retention,(k.this_claim-k.retention)::numeric(14,2) as amount_due from claims k where k.id=$1

sections.title: Work completed by task
sections.sql: select t.code,t.name,t.budget_revenue as contract_value,t.pct_complete,round(t.budget_revenue*t.pct_complete/100,2) as completed_value from project_tasks t join claims k on k.project_id=t.project_id where k.id=$1 order by t.code

name: purchase-order
title: Purchase order
for_each: select id,code from orders where kind='purchase' and status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Order
sections.note: Draft for review. Amounts exclude GST.
sections.sql: select code,partner as supplier,warehouse as deliver_to,project,task,status,due_on,total,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from v_orders where id=$1

sections.title: Lines
sections.sql: select l.line_no,i.code,i.name,i.uom,l.quantity,l.completed as received,l.unit_price,(l.quantity*l.unit_price)::numeric(14,2) as line_amount from order_lines l join items i on i.id=l.item_id where l.order_id=$1 order by l.line_no

name: sales-confirmation
title: Sales order confirmation
for_each: select id,code from orders where kind='sales' and status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Order
sections.note: Draft for review. Amounts exclude GST.
sections.sql: select code,partner as customer,reference as your_reference,warehouse as dispatch_from,status,due_on,total,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from v_orders where id=$1

sections.title: Lines
sections.sql: select l.line_no,i.code,i.name,i.uom,l.quantity,l.completed as shipped,l.unit_price,(l.quantity*l.unit_price)::numeric(14,2) as line_amount from order_lines l join items i on i.id=l.item_id where l.order_id=$1 order by l.line_no

name: retention-statement
title: Retention money statement
for_each: select distinct v.id,v.code from vendors v join retentions r on r.vendor_id=v.id

sections.title: Subcontractor
sections.note: The information a holder gives the subcontractor when retention is first withheld and at least every three months after (NZ). Check against docs/compliance.md before sending.
sections.sql: select v.name as subcontractor,(select name from settings limit 1) as held_by,current_date as statement_date,(select sum(amount) from retentions r where r.vendor_id=v.id and r.released_on is null) as total_held from vendors v where v.id=$1

sections.title: Amounts retained
sections.sql: select r.code,p.code as project,p.name as contract,r.withheld_on,r.amount,r.release_due,r.trust_ref as held_in,coalesce(r.released_on::text,'held') as released from retentions r join projects p on p.id=r.project_id where r.vendor_id=$1 order by r.withheld_on

sections.title: Position
sections.note: Forecast cost is actual cost scaled by percent complete; tasks not started use their budget.
sections.sql: select code,name,customer,status,contract_value,budget_cost,actual_cost,committed_cost,forecast_cost,(contract_value-forecast_cost)::numeric(14,2) as forecast_margin,earned_revenue,claimed from v_projects where id=$1

sections.title: Tasks
sections.sql: select code,name,pct_complete,budget_cost,actual_cost,committed_cost,forecast_cost,earned_revenue from v_tasks where project_id=$1 order by code
